subject: Kestrel Systems - High latency & error spike: RCA request and next steps
messages:
From: Oliver Ross <oliver.ross@kestrel.io>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.singh@kestrel.io>
Date: Sun, 25 Jul 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Production spike - latency and errors (Kestrel)

Kimberly / Redwood team,

We saw a large, sustained latency spike starting ~08:40 PDT and a corresponding error rate increase peaking at ~2.5% for our inference route (model: rwd-13b-quant). This impacted a subset of API keys for our checkout flow. Throughput dropped and timeouts started at ~09:05; our ops team rolled traffic to a backup region which reduced customer impact.

Can you share an immediate RCA and corrective actions? Our execs (VP of Engineering and Head of Ops) are asking for a timeline for fixes and whether we'll be eligible for a credit per SLA. I've attached a short metrics export.

Ticket: KES-4721
Impact: 17% of requests for checkout route delayed >1.5s; 2 customer incidents reported.

Thanks,
Oliver
Oliver Ross
SRE Lead, Kestrel Systems
oliver.ross@kestrel.io

Attachment: metrics_snapshot_20270725.png (PNG, 420KB)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Oliver Ross <oliver.ross@kestrel.io>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 25 Jul 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Production spike - latency and errors (Kestrel)

Hi Oliver — thanks for the heads up and the snapshot. Sorry for the disruption. We’ve opened an internal incident and are prioritizing a short RCA. Immediate notes from triage:
- Evidence of increased KV cache misses for the inference runtime during the window.
- Autoscaler shows several pod launch failures followed by a surge in cold-starts at 08:42 PDT.
- Error traces point to a transient kernel mismatch in the quantized execution path on the instance family serving your reserved pool.

Next steps we’ll take in the next 48 hours:
1) Collect full traces + KV cache TTLs (owner: Grace) — ETA 08/26 EOD.
2) Hotfix to adjust pre-warm pool sizing and autoscaler thresholds (owner: Marcus) — ETA 07/27 11:59 PDT.
3) Draft RCA for your review (owner: Kimberly) — ETA 07/27 COB.

We’ll schedule a readout with your ops and our execs tomorrow (07/26) 11:00 PDT if that works. I’m cc’ing Marcus and Grace to keep them in the loop.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Head of Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai

Attachment: kestrel_rca_draft_v1.pdf (initial notes)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 26 Jul 2027 08:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Production spike - latency and errors (Kestrel)

Kimberly — quick internal summary before the readout. Triage done overnight:
- Root cause (prelim): simultaneous kernel dispatch to quantized execution on an older CUDA + OS combo on the reserved pool instances; combined with a recent tokenizer change that increased average sequence length by ~20%, leading to more frequent KV cache evictions and longer per-token latencies.
- Contributing factor: autoscaler race condition — when a burst arrives, new pods boot but the prefix cache isn't hydrated; we saw ~30s extra token latency per request during cold paths.

Immediate mitigations I want us to execute now:
A) Forced fallback to the non-quantized kernel for the reserved pool (reduces the mismatch risk) — owner: Marcus — immediate deployment in next 60m.
B) Increase pre-warm pool to N+25% for Kestrel’s reserved pool — owner: Grace — ETA 07/27 03:00 PDT.
C) Patch autoscaler debounce to avoid simultaneous scale-ups that cause cache thrash — owner: Karthik (infra) — ETA 08/02.

We should also prepare an exec slide summarizing impact (SLO misses, customer incidents, mitigation timeline) — Kimberly, can you own the external readout and the credit/terms ask?

-Marcus
VP, Product & Infrastructure
Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.ai

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Oliver Ross <oliver.ross@kestrel.io>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.singh@kestrel.io>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 27 Jul 2027 12:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Production spike - latency and errors (Kestrel)

Oliver / Priya — thank you again for your patience. Attached is the initial RCA draft and an action tracker. Summary for your execs:
- What happened: A confluence of factors — an unexpected tokenizer change increased sequence lengths, triggering higher KV cache churn; at the same time the reserved pool experienced quantized kernel dispatch to instances with a mismatched runtime (older driver), causing intermittent errors and elevated per-token cost.
- Impact: Peak error rate ~2.5%, ~17% of checkout requests >1.5s; mitigation by routing to backup region reduced customer impact.
- Immediate mitigations applied (07/26–07/27):
  • Forced fallback to non-quantized kernel for your reserved pool (rolled 07/26 09:05 PDT).
  • Increased pre-warm pool for your reserved pool by +25% (rolled 07/27 03:20 PDT).
  • Temporary autoscaler debounce disabled to avoid synchronized cold starts (rolled 07/26 10:00 PDT).

Commitments we are making to close this out:
- Full RCA with timeline and permanent fixes (incl. kernel compatibility check and tokenizer rollback plan) — delivery: 08/02/2027 (owner: Kimberly).
- Autoscaler debounce patch and regression test (owner: Karthik) — delivery: 08/02/2027.
- Kernel compatibility enforcement in CI for quantized paths (owner: Marcus) — delivery: 08/09/2027.
- Compensation review per SLA and support credit proposal (owner: Kimberly + Finance) — proposal by 08/04/2027.

We’ve also created an action tracker (kestrel_action_tracker.xlsx) with owners and dates; I’ve attached the draft. Can we lock a follow-up exec readout on 08/03 10:00 PDT?

Apologies again — we take this seriously and are prioritizing remediation and prevention work.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Head of Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference

Attachment: kestrel_action_tracker.xlsx (owners & ETA)

From: Oliver Ross <oliver.ross@kestrel.io>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.singh@kestrel.io>
Date: Wed, 28 Jul 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Production spike - latency and errors (Kestrel)

Kimberly — thanks for the clear summary and the tracker. A few requests/questions from our side:
- We need formal confirmation on what caused the tokenization change (internal to our deploy or something that came from Redwood). Kestrel CI shows no deploy in that window on our side.
- Please include a timeline we can share with procurement for the credit request.
- We’ll take the 08/03 10:00 PDT readout. Please include Marcus and someone from finance to discuss credits.

Also, two high-priority asks for the action tracker:
1) Add a verification step to test workloads with +25% sequence length (owner: Kestrel + Redwood).
2) Provide an endpoint-level circuit breaker config that we can opt into for checkout flows (owner: Redwood infra).

We appreciate the responsiveness — this impacted 3 customers and an internal incident.

—Oliver
SRE Lead, Kestrel Systems

Subject: Kestrel action tracker - owners, status, and next exec readout

Team — following the readout with Kestrel today (08/03 readout confirmed, prep session done), updated tracker and current status:
- Kimberly: Final RCA and compensation proposal — draft delivered 08/02; finalizing with Finance; target 08/04 for proposal to Kestrel.
- Marcus: Kernel compatibility gating in CI — PR open, running integration matrix across 4 instance families; ETA 08/09.
- Grace: Pre-warm pool sizing policy updated and automated scaling rule applied to reserved pools; rolled 07/27; monitoring shows 85% reduction in cold-start traces for Kestrel routes.
- Karthik: Autoscaler debounce + regression tests — in progress; scheduled canary 08/05.

Open items for exec readout (08/03 10:00 PDT):
1) Compensation range & SLA credit mechanics (Finance)
2) RCA narrative and permanent mitigations (Marcus/Kimberly)
3) Post-deployment verification plan (Kestrel + Redwood)

Please update the tracker with any change in ETA. I’ll keep Kestrel in the loop and move to closure once PRs and verification pass.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Head of Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference
